message: ゆうべはおたのしみでしたね
What's with this tension!?

name: Synn
message: 「Is something wrong with you two?」

name: Azel
message: 「Nothing's wrong」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um, you know, I'm just not used to this kind of thing!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Right?」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't look to me for agreement. I don't care if we don't talk」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but try to get along, okay?」

name: Azel
message: 「We simply have nothing to talk about」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah, that's right! It's nothing to worry about!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm」

name: Paqy
message: 「Boy, this does not bode well for the road ahead」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Looks like you had fun last night」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wh-What are you saying, Lolo-chan! Nothing like that could ever happen between the two of us!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What do you mean by "like that"?」

name: Paqy
message: 「You don't even know what it means?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I heard this is the standard greeting for a man and a woman who spent the night at the same inn」

name: Ria
message: 「Were you two up late playing games or something? You shouldn't stay up too late, you know」

name: Azel
message: 「I was tired last night, so I went straight to sleep」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Phew...」

name: Misa
message: 「Tired!? S-Sakura-kun, you went that hard right off the bat!? You're the worst!」

name: Synn
message: 「I have no idea what anyone's talking about」

name: Paqy
message: 「So soft is totally fine then?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course it isn't!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What do you mean by hard and soft?」

name: Misa
message: 「Uh, um, th-that's... I can't say it!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Azel-chan. Hard or soft, if you eat ice cream in the middle of the night, you'll get fat」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah! Nice one, Ria-chan! Though Master Synn's house doesn't have any fancy stuff like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it's winter now, though. We've got eggs and milk, so maybe I'll make some for the first time in a while」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Well, coming from Synn, that sounds about right」

name: Azel
message: 「What is ice cream?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a delicious sweet. You can only eat it in the winter」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's just because you can't afford to buy it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Looks like you two had quite the fun night last night~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You too?!」

name: Azel
message: 「You as well?」

name: Synn
message: 「What on earth is going on?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh my~? Someone beat you to the punch~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Buuut~ it looks like nobody actually beat you to it after all, lucky you, Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up!」

name: Synn
message: 「What does she mean?」

name: Azel
message: 「Incomprehensible」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's better if you don't get it, just don't... *sigh*...」
